description: Your own agent inside a live Google Meet or Zoom call. Local-first, no hosted service.

cmd.description: The package ships two binaries; -p picks the MCP one rather than the bridge server.
cmd.name: -p

name: io.github.krystiangw/meet-live-assist

environmentVariables.description: Base URL of the bridge server on this machine. Defaults to http://127.0.0.1:8848, which is right unless you moved the port.
environmentVariables.name: MLA_URL

environmentVariables.description: Where the bridge server writes. The adapter reads the access token from <dir>/.mla-token, and asks the running server for this path when it can, so it is normally unnecessary.
environmentVariables.name: TRANSCRIPTS_DIR

environmentVariables.description: Access token for the bridge server. Only needed when the token file cannot be read; the adapter finds it by itself in the normal case.
environmentVariables.name: MLA_TOKEN

runtimeArguments.description: The package ships two binaries; -p picks the MCP one rather than the bridge server.
runtimeArguments.name: -p
